onboarding.title: Welcome to ViolaDocs
onboarding.welcome: Welcome! Let's take a quick tour to help you get started.

welcome.title: Welcome to ViolaDocs
welcome.description: ViolaDocs is an AI-powered document intelligence platform. This tour will help you navigate the main features.

sidebar.title: Sidebar Navigation
sidebar.description: Use the sidebar to navigate between different sections. The menu adapts based on your permissions.

llmSetup.title: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Setup LLM Settings First
llmSetup.description: Before using AI features (chatbot, search, auto-tagging), you MUST configure LLM and Embedding models in Settings. Go to Settings → LLM Settings tab, configure Ollama Base URL, and select/download LLM and Embedding models. The system requires these models to function properly.

library.title: Library
library.description: Your main dashboard showing an overview of all your documents and quick access to key features.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: View and manage all your documents. Browse, filter, and organize your document collection.

upload.title: Upload Documents
upload.description: Upload new documents to your library. Supports PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, and image files.

scan.title: Scan Inbox
scan.description: Manage documents scanned from physical scanners. Process and organize scanned documents here.

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Organize your documents into folders for better structure and easier management.

search.title: Search
search.description: Search through your documents using keyword, semantic, or hybrid search. Find what you need quickly.

recycleBin.title: Recycle Bin
recycleBin.description: View and restore deleted documents. Documents are permanently deleted after the retention period.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Manage your workflow tasks. View pending, completed, and overdue tasks assigned to you.

chatbot.title: AI Chatbot
chatbot.description: Ask questions about your documents using AI. The chatbot understands your document content and provides intelligent answers.

admin.title: Admin Section
admin.description: Administrative functions including user management, device configuration, groups, settings, reports, roles, and AI job monitoring.

maintainer.title: System Config
maintainer.description: System configuration settings. Only available to maintainers for advanced system management.

finish.title: You're All Set!
finish.description: You've completed the tour. Start exploring ViolaDocs and make the most of its powerful features!
